query: SELECT DISTINCT o.id FROM conversations o JOIN idempotency w ON w.conversation_id=o.id WHERE o.workspace_id=(SELECT workspace_id FROM conversations WHERE id=$1) AND o.id<>$1 AND o.state='active' AND w.execution_status='queued' AND NOT EXISTS(SELECT 1 FROM sandbox_instances s WHERE s.conversation_id=o.id) AND w.created_at < COALESCE((SELECT MIN(h.created_at) FROM idempotency h WHERE h.conversation_id=$1 AND h.execution_status='queued'), 'infinity'::timestamptz)
